feat(cl,app): unwind continuous C at clear links against the machine's stated C travel

A C-stamped live-tool path states its spindle angle unwrapped, so the
rings of a Rotary Contour wind past the shipped mill-turn's -360..360
and the machine check refused them. cl::unwind_c shifts each stretch
between clear links by whole turns into the stated travel, writing each
rewind as the part-frame orbit it is (rapid chords at the link point,
split to the op tolerance) so verify and the post see it; a stretch no
rewind can fit refuses by name. rotary_gate runs it after stamp_c when
the machine's C states a travel.

Refs #33

fix(post,app,cl): cap the C composite feed by the machine's stated rates; refuse Parallel/Offset where C needs a rewind; harden unwind_c

- fanuc-lathe.cps caps each C block's composite F so its X/Z part stays
  within machine.feedRateMax and its C part within the C rate the
  machine states (rotaries[].speeds, now in the script's inventory);
  an unstated C rate is not capped.
- Rotary Parallel and Rotary Offset do not unwind: on a stated C travel
  they post only what fits as stamped and refuse by name otherwise.
- unwind_c refuses a non-finite point and a broken chain by name.

fix(cl,app): the radial C-unwind link is opt-in; Rotary Contour links over the axial plane only

unwind_c takes a radial flag: the retract cylinder counts as a clear
link only when the caller admits it. Rotary Contour does not, so a
contour stretch whose only clear point is radial is refused by name.
The radial branch is pinned by its own unit tests (unwinds on the
cylinder strictly beyond the cut; not at or inside the cut radius).
